findings.evidence: scripts/sc/skill_package_replay.py::replay_metadata constructs a validate-package command but records a separate python -c file-read command for each Consumer; route transitions are synthesized from those reads.
findings.required_fix: Execute each applicable repository Consumer call surface through its declared lifecycle and record caller identity, route, verdict and diagnostic before and after rollback.

findings.evidence: verify_fresh_replay archives selected paths but calls validate_package and current_snapshot_binding against the process-global ROOT and original validator; the fresh checkout is not the execution root of the replay.
findings.required_fix: Reconstruct all pinned inputs in a fresh checkout, execute the validator/replay from that checkout, then compare the result and identities with the pinned reference.

findings.evidence: matrix_case_result defaults stable_target and candidate_target to the same target and only materializes copies when subject_contract is explicitly supplied; ordinary cases therefore do not prove independent Stable/Candidate fixture/state execution.
findings.required_fix: Require explicit independent Stable/Candidate target, fixture and state bindings for every applicable Matrix Case and reject same-subject execution.

findings.evidence: candidate_external_trust and independent_validator_verification accept compatibility records that omit source/rule declarations and derive a source from the selected validator; target/validator observations are therefore not sufficient independent trust proof.
findings.required_fix: Require declared source, content and rule bindings, independently execute the bound validator against the actual target, and reject missing or self-attested trust metadata.
